{{Quote|Imagine ol' Piit here decked out in the finery of a Sakiyan princess!"<br />"I clean up jes' fine. Unlike a grimy spice-goblin like yerself.|[[Sabo/Legends|Sabo]] and Piit|<ref name="Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>}}
'''Piit''', also known by the nickname "'''Peg Leg Piit'''," was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] member of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
"Peg Leg" Piit was nicknamed for her purple peg leg in place of her missing right leg, made with [[Phrik/Legends|Phrik]] alloy.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> At some point around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref>Since {{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}} depicts [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] as still alive, this short story must take place before {{TCW|The Gungan General}}.</ref> Piit, alongside [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], sabotaged the ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' to kidnap several of the liner's passengers.<ref name="Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref>{{TCWdates|111}}</ref> she assisted with the capture of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the drugging of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who came to claim the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="DC">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>

[[20 BBY/Legends|Two years later]], Piit was one the pirates that assisted Hondo during the hijacking onboard the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']]. She shot at, [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]], but was knocked unconscious.<ref name="A Test of Strength">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref> She was serving drinks to two pirates when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his forces stormed the base, and shot dead the pirates she was standing next to.<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref> She later fought in a [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|skirmish]] after half of Hondo's pirates join [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] in their conquest for power. She utilized a blaster pistol during the fight and killed several pirates before being forced to retreat into the ruins of the base with Ohnaka and the rest of his forces, as well as Obi-Wan Kenobi, after Adi Gallia was slain by Opress. She survived the battle and helped to salvage valuables from the Nightbrothers' destroyed starship.<ref name="Revival episode">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>
